title: Composed verifier and clause evaluation
statement: Let $n>0$, let $V$ be a Boolean proof-checking system with input length $n$, proof length $\ell$, and query count $r$, and let a seedwise three-CNF reduction for $V$ use parameter $K$. For any Boolean word on the input and extended-proof addresses, and any seed $(s,q)$ of the composed verifier, that verifier accepts the word at the seed if and only if the clause indexed by $q$ for $s$ evaluates to $-1$ on the sign assignment induced by the word at the corresponding composition addresses.
